description: Animated briefs. Each builds on a core prompt (basedOn) and adds numbered, checkable motion requirements. Slugs start with 'animated-' so generations save to their own benchmark folders.

prompts.title: A stapler on a table (Animated)
prompts.prompt:
a stapler on a table.

This is the animated brief: draw the picture above and bring it to life. The stapler staples a sheet of paper in a steady loop.

Requirements:
1. The upper arm pivots down around the rear hinge (rotation origin at the hinge, not the arm's centre) and springs back up.
2. A sheet of paper slides in under the head before each press and out after it.
3. On impact the base gives a small squash and short impact lines appear, then fade.
4. The table stays still; the shadow under the arm shortens as it closes.
5. The first frame already reads as a complete, finished picture.
6. Every animation loops forever and restarts without a visible jump or snap.

Deliver one self-contained SVG with a viewBox. Animate only with SMIL (<animate>, <animateTransform>, <animateMotion>, <set>) or CSS @keyframes inside a <style> element. No JavaScript, no external images or fonts.
prompts.notes: Watch for: the arm rotating around its middle or the canvas origin; paper passing through the stapler; the impact effect out of sync with the press.

prompts.title: Bonsai Tree (Animated)
prompts.prompt:
Bonsai Tree: Twisted trunk, tiered green leaf clumps, Zen style.

This is the animated brief: draw the picture above and bring it to life. A calm breeze moves through the bonsai.

Requirements:
1. Each tiered leaf clump sways with a small rotation anchored where it joins its branch, with staggered timing so the clumps never move in unison.
2. The twisted trunk and the pot stay rooted and still.
3. Three small leaves drift down on curved paths, fading out near the ground, and re-enter from the canopy.
4. A soft background element (sun, mist band or ensō circle) breathes slowly in opacity over 8 seconds or longer.
5. The first frame already reads as a complete, finished picture.
6. Every animation loops forever and restarts without a visible jump or snap.

Deliver one self-contained SVG with a viewBox. Animate only with SMIL (<animate>, <animateTransform>, <animateMotion>, <set>) or CSS @keyframes inside a <style> element. No JavaScript, no external images or fonts.
prompts.notes: Watch for: the whole tree rotating as one piece; clumps pivoting around their own centres and detaching; falling leaves popping back into view.

prompts.title: Cactus in a Pot (Animated)
prompts.prompt:
Cactus in a Pot: Flat design, pastel green, sharp white needles.

This is the animated brief: draw the picture above and bring it to life. The potted cactus has a gentle flat-design idle loop.

Requirements:
1. The cactus squashes and stretches slightly, like breathing, with the scale anchored at the soil line, not its centre.
2. A small flower on top blooms: petals scale open from its centre, hold, then close.
3. The sharp white needles twinkle one after another with a staggered opacity pulse.
4. The pot never moves or scales.
5. The first frame already reads as a complete, finished picture.
6. Every animation loops forever and restarts without a visible jump or snap.

Deliver one self-contained SVG with a viewBox. Animate only with SMIL (<animate>, <animateTransform>, <animateMotion>, <set>) or CSS @keyframes inside a <style> element. No JavaScript, no external images or fonts.
prompts.notes: Watch for: scaling from the SVG origin so the cactus slides off the pot; every needle flashing together; the flower drifting away from its stem.

prompts.title: Chameleon (Animated)
prompts.prompt:
Chameleon: Spiraled tail, multi-colored skin segments.

This is the animated brief: draw the picture above and bring it to life. The chameleon changes colour and catches a fly.

Requirements:
1. The skin segments cycle through at least three colour palettes as a wave that travels from head to tail, not all at once.
2. The spiraled tail curls a little tighter and relaxes.
3. A fly buzzes on a looping figure-eight path near the head, and the eye swivels to track it.
4. Once per loop the tongue shoots out in a straight line to the fly and retracts; the fly vanishes, then reappears for the next cycle.
5. The first frame already reads as a complete, finished picture.
6. Every animation loops forever and restarts without a visible jump or snap.

Deliver one self-contained SVG with a viewBox. Animate only with SMIL (<animate>, <animateTransform>, <animateMotion>, <set>) or CSS @keyframes inside a <style> element. No JavaScript, no external images or fonts.
prompts.notes: Watch for: every segment changing colour at the same instant; the tongue missing the fly's position; the eye not rotating around its own centre.

prompts.title: Circuit Board Heart (Animated)
prompts.prompt:
Circuit Board Heart: Red pathways connecting silver solder points.

This is the animated brief: draw the picture above and bring it to life. The circuit board heart beats and sends current along its traces.

Requirements:
1. The heart gives a double lub-dub beat (two quick scale pulses from its centre, then a rest) every 1.2 to 1.6 seconds.
2. Bright pulses travel along at least four different red pathways from solder point to solder point, using stroke-dasharray/stroke-dashoffset or animateMotion on the trace paths.
3. Each silver solder point flashes as a pulse arrives at it.
4. The board background stays static.
5. The first frame already reads as a complete, finished picture.
6. Every animation loops forever and restarts without a visible jump or snap.

Deliver one self-contained SVG with a viewBox. Animate only with SMIL (<animate>, <animateTransform>, <animateMotion>, <set>) or CSS @keyframes inside a <style> element. No JavaScript, no external images or fonts.
prompts.notes: Watch for: pulses that do not follow the traces; one uniform throb instead of a two-part beat; solder flashes out of sync with pulse arrival.

prompts.title: Commonwealth of dominica (Animated)
prompts.prompt:
Commonwealth of Dominica

This is the animated brief: draw the picture above and bring it to life. The flag of the Commonwealth of Dominica waves in the wind.

Requirements:
1. The flag keeps its correct design: green field, a yellow/black/white triple-banded cross, and a red disc at the centre holding the Sisserou parrot ringed by ten green stars.
2. A wave ripples across the flag from hoist to fly: its outline and bands bend (path morphing or a displacement filter), not just a skew or slide.
3. Bands of light and shade travel with the wave.
4. The flagpole stays still and the hoist edge stays attached to it.
5. The first frame already reads as a complete, finished picture.
6. Every animation loops forever and restarts without a visible jump or snap.

Deliver one self-contained SVG with a viewBox. Animate only with SMIL (<animate>, <animateTransform>, <animateMotion>, <set>) or CSS @keyframes inside a <style> element. No JavaScript, no external images or fonts.
prompts.notes: Watch for: wrong band order in the cross; a flag that only slides or skews; the stars drifting out of the red disc during the wave.

prompts.title: Compass (Animated)
prompts.prompt:
Compass: Nautical star design, aged brass, needle pointing North.

This is the animated brief: draw the picture above and bring it to life. The compass needle settles on North like a real magnetic needle.

Requirements:
1. The needle swings past North and oscillates with decreasing amplitude (at least three swings, damped with keySplines or keyTimes), settles, then after a pause is knocked off and repeats.
2. The needle rotates about the central pivot.
3. The nautical star rose stays fixed.
4. A glint of light sweeps once across the aged brass bezel each cycle.
5. The first frame already reads as a complete, finished picture.
6. Every animation loops forever and restarts without a visible jump or snap.

Deliver one self-contained SVG with a viewBox. Animate only with SMIL (<animate>, <animateTransform>, <animateMotion>, <set>) or CSS @keyframes inside a <style> element. No JavaScript, no external images or fonts.
prompts.notes: Watch for: the needle rotating around the wrong point; linear back-and-forth with no damping; the whole compass rotating.

prompts.title: Corgi (Animated)

2. The ears perk up and relax every few seconds.
3. The eyes blink with a quick vertical squash on a different rhythm from the ears.

Deliver one self-contained SVG with a viewBox. Animate only with SMIL (<animate>, <animateTransform>, <animateMotion>, <set>) or CSS @keyframes inside a <style> element. No JavaScript, no external images or fonts.
prompts.notes: Watch for: every motion sharing one duration so the loop looks mechanical; blinks that scale the whole head; the tail detaching from the body.

prompts.title: Crystal Ball (Animated)

3. The neon red sensors pulse and a scan beam sweeps the ground below.
4. A soft ground shadow shrinks as the drone rises and grows as it drops.

prompts.notes: Watch for: rotors rotating around the drone's centre instead of their hubs; rotors left behind when the body bobs; a shadow out of step with the altitude.

prompts.title: Electric Guitar (Animated)
prompts.prompt:
Electric Guitar: Stratocaster shape, sunburst finish.

This is the animated brief: draw the picture above and bring it to life. The electric guitar is being strummed.

Requirements:
1. The six strings vibrate with the largest amplitude mid-string and none at the nut and bridge (path morph between bowed shapes).
2. The strings are struck in a strum from top to bottom with a short delay between strings, and each vibration decays.
3. Musical notes or sound waves emerge from the body and fade.
4. A sheen slides along the sunburst finish.
5. The first frame already reads as a complete, finished picture.
6. Every animation loops forever and restarts without a visible jump or snap.

Deliver one self-contained SVG with a viewBox. Animate only with SMIL (<animate>, <animateTransform>, <animateMotion>, <set>) or CSS @keyframes inside a <style> element. No JavaScript, no external images or fonts.
prompts.notes: Watch for: strings moving as rigid lines with the ends moving too; every string in unison; the whole guitar shaking.

prompts.title: Elephant Silhouette (Animated)

This is the animated brief: draw the picture above and bring it to life. The elephant silhouette walks in front of the setting sun.

Requirements:
1. The elephant walks in place with a four-beat gait: legs swing from the shoulder and hip in the correct alternating order.
2. The trunk swings gently and the body rises and falls with each step.
3. The large orange sun sinks slowly as the sky gradient deepens, and the loop returns seamlessly.
4. Grass or dust scrolls past on the ground to sell the forward walk.

prompts.notes: Watch for: legs pivoting around their feet; front and back legs moving in sync; a visible jump when the sun resets.

prompts.title: Feather Pen (Animated)

Requirements:
1. The quill lifts, dips into the inkwell, rises with a drop of ink that falls back in, and moves over to the paper.
2. A handwritten word or flourish draws itself on the paper (stroke-dashoffset), following the nib's position as it moves.
3. The feather's barbs flutter slightly as the quill moves.
4. The writing fades out before the next cycle.

prompts.notes: Watch for: the nib and the line being drawn in different places; ink appearing all at once; the quill rotating about its centre instead of the grip.

prompts.title: Flamingo (Animated)
